# libgrub_editenv

Reads and writes the GRUB environment block (`grubenv`): the 1024-byte
file that GRUB's `load_env` and `save_env` use.

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Module | `libgrub_editenv` (shared library) |
| Header | `libgrub_editenv.h`, namespace `libgrub_editenv` |
| Builds for | Platform, vendor, recovery, host |
| Depends on | `libbase` |
| Used by | `grub-editenv`, `libgrub_boot_control` |

## The format

```
# GRUB Environment Block
# WARNING: Do not edit this file by tools other than grub-editenv!!!
key=value
key2=value2
###############...   (padding up to 1024 bytes)
```

| Rule | Value |
|------|-------|
| Total size | Exactly 1024 bytes |
| Header | The two comment lines above (94 bytes) |
| Room for variables | 930 bytes |
| Lines | `key=value\n`, written sorted by key |
| Padding | `#` up to the end |
| Value | Everything after the first `=`. Other `=` are part of the value |

## API

All in `GrubEnvMap` (`std::map<std::string, std::string>`) terms.

| Function | Does |
|----------|------|
| `ValidateHeader(content)` | `true` if the content starts with the header |
| `ValidateLength(content)` | `true` if the size is exactly 1024 |
| `Validate(content)` | Both of the above |
| `ParseStringToMap(content, &map)` | Parse a block. Clears the map first |
| `LoadFdToMap(fd, &map)` | Same, from a file descriptor |
| `LoadFileToMap(path, &map)` | Same, from a path (follows symlinks) |
| `GenerateStringFromMap(map, trim)` | Build the 1024-byte block. Empty string on failure |
| `WriteFdFromMap(fd, map, trim)` | Write it to a file descriptor |
| `WriteFileFromMap(path, map, trim)` | Write it to a path (follows symlinks) |
| `TrimOverflowVarsFromString(&content)` | Drop lines from the end until it fits |

## Behavior

### Reading

| Input | Result |
|-------|--------|
| Wrong header or size | `false`, map is left empty |
| Only padding after the header | `true`, empty map |
| Line without `=` | Skipped |
| Same key twice | The later one wins |
| Trailing padding line | Ignored |

### Writing

| Case | `trim = false` (default) | `trim = true` |
|------|--------------------------|---------------|
| Fits in 1024 bytes | Written, padded | Same |
| Too big | Fails, nothing is written | Drops variables from the end (the keys that sort last) until it fits |
| Even the header does not fit | Fails | Fails. A block without a header is never produced |

If the block cannot be generated, the function returns `false` and
nothing is written.

## Example

```cpp
#include <libgrub_editenv.h>

using namespace libgrub_editenv;

GrubEnvMap env;
if (!LoadFileToMap("/mnt/vendor/persist/grubenv", &env)) return false;

env["android_theme"] = "2";
return WriteFileFromMap("/mnt/vendor/persist/grubenv", env);
```

## Limits

- No backslash or newline escaping. Do not put `\` or newlines in
  values.
- Not atomic: the file is rewritten in place. Callers that need
  consistency (such as `libgrub_boot_control`) hold their own lock.
- A file of any size other than 1024 bytes is rejected, not repaired.
